title: Quick Flaky Spanish Bread Pa Amb Tomaquet
description: A malty, flaky, one-pot Spanish dish featuring coriander seeds, this Pa Amb Tomaquet is a delicious and easy to make bread, perfect for a snack or light lunch
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, coriander seeds, salt, sugar, and yeast
Gradually add olive oil and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for 10 minutes
Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place them in the air fryer basket
Cook the bread for 5 minutes or until it is golden brown and crispy
Serve the bread with raw tomato and a drizzle of olive oil
